coverage_claim: Batch A covers the groups and grape lessons enumerated here. It is not a complete Level 1 or Level 2 qualification, an official endorsement, or expert verification. Regional wine-specific profiles, label terms, additional vineyard and production detail, sparkling/fortified styles and service are separate integration work.
study_inheritance: L1 items are inherited by L2; L2 items are inherited by L3 and L4. No advanced items were lowered.
